VKOSPI 재구축 검증: 2020-03 92 / 2026-04 110 / 2017 50 — KRX official 정합. WT_001 anti-hedge 본질 제약 해소 = single-asset overlay → cross-section signal 변환. Best single signal s3 = -(VRP_bkm × vol_60d_lag1) IC -0.037 ICIR -0.209 t_NW -3.02 sub_stab 1.00.
